ABOUT THE AUTHOR

Yeonmi Park was born in Hyesan, North Korea, in 1993. She currently lives in New York City and is a student at Columbia University.

Yeonmi Park's first book was her memoirs titled In Order to Live: A North Korean Girl's Journey to Freedom (2015), which was published in the United States by Penguin Press . It was created as a collaboration between Park and the veteran ghost writer Maryanne Vollers , who had previously worked with notable public figures including Hillary Clinton and Ashley Judd . [ 3 ] As of July 2023 In Order to Live had sold over 100,000 copies. [ 3 ]
